name.text: Evaluation of Double Integral over a Rectangular Region

questiontext.text:
Compute double integral over the indicated rectangle.

\( \displaystyle \int \int_R {@question_expr@} dA \quad R=[{@lower_x@},{@upper_x@} ] \times [{@lower_y@},{@upper_y@}]\)


[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Step1: In order to integrate the function with respect to \(y\), we need to use \(u\)-substitution.

\(\displaystyle \int_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@}{@question_expr@} dy\)

Let \(u={@let_u@} \rightarrow {@diff_u@}\) and \({@var_y@}\)

Now let us substitute the above in the original equation.

\( \begin{align} \displaystyle \int_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@}{@question_expr@} dy &=\int_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@}{@rhs(var_y)@}{@%e^u@} dy \\ &=\int_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@} {@expr1@} \\ &={@1/2@} \int_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@} e^{u}du \\ &={@1/2@} \left(e^{u}\right) \left.\begin{matrix}& \\ & \end{matrix}\right|_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@} \\ &={@1/2@} \left(e^{{@power_e@}}\right) \left.\begin{matrix}& \\ & \end{matrix}\right|_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@} \\ &={@ta1@} \end{align} \)

Step 2: The next step is to repeat step 1, but integrate wrt to \(x\),

\( \begin{align} \displaystyle \int \int_R {@question_expr@} dA &=\int_{@lower_x@}^{@upper_x@} {@ta1@} dx \\ &= \left({@int_xx@}\right) \left.\begin{matrix}& \\ & \end{matrix}\right|_{@lower_x@}^{@upper_x@} \\ &={@int_x@} \\ &={@ta1@} \end{align} \)

\(\displaystyle \int \int_R {@question_expr@} dA = \int_{@lower_x@}^{@upper_x@} \int_{@lower_y@}^{@upper_y@}{@question_expr@} dydx \)

Now,integrate the function wrt to \(y\) first, then afterwards wrt to \(y\).
